method: Balberg+ 2002 gravothermal timescale + empirical enhancement factor. Tested for JVAS B1938+666 perturber (M_halo = 10^9 M_sun, V_max = 35 km/s).
verdict: Gravothermal core-collapse gives max ~100x enhancement, but JVAS requires ~3000x. JVAS remains a structural limitation. Phase 50 reclassification is the most accurate framing.
